name: web-red-blurred-gradient-background-with-warp-dialog-buttons
title: Deep red mesh of blurred blobs with a small 'Welcome to Warp Dialog' title and three buttons in the centre
whatItIs: A screen of dark maroon with large blurred bright red blobs at the upper left and lower right, a white 'Welcome to Warp Dialog' heading at the centre, an outlined Open Dialog button and two buttons (light Get Started, black Learn More), and a small file name in the corner.
whatItMeans: Warm and dramatic; blurred red light gives plain buttons a stage.
techniques: Use a blurred red mesh as the backdrop.
Contrast a light and a dark button.
Add a code-file label in the corner.

vocabulary.definition: A blend of blurred colour blobs.
A background used to present a component.
A light and a dark button beside each other.
